sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA and perused the record.
None has appeared for respondent no.2 despite notice.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.0282 of 2023, under Section 363, 366, 376 IPC & Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, P.S. Dalmau, District Rare Bareli.
3. In terms of the FIR which was registered as a missing person report, it was alleged that the daughter of the informant was enticed by the applicant and two other co-accused.
In the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., the victim admitted that they were talking since the last three years and Mohit vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ...

entities.text: Mohit vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: she went on her own to the applicant and thereafter, they both went to Kanpur and thereafter to Delhi.
It was also stated that they stayed at the home of applicant's relative from 21.09.2023.

In the statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., she reiterated the same statement as narrated in the statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., however, she specifically stated that no physical relations were formed and she wanted to go with the applicant.
The medical on record does not corroborate the prosecution story.
There is no document to conclusively determine the age of the victim in terms of the document specified under Section 94 of Juvenile Justice Act.
4. Learned AGA has opposed the bail application.

5. Considering the two statements coupled with the fact that the applicant has only one criminal history of an offence under Section 323, 504, 506 IPC, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
In view thereof, the application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Mohit be released on bail in aforesaid FIR number on his furnishing a personal bond with two sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
